disclaimer: DESIGN AID — computed by tekton's calc engine from the job spec. All values must be reviewed and stamped by the licensed engineer of record before construction/permit. Simplified NEC-style rules; conductor derating, voltage drop, series ratings and coordination are NOT evaluated.
codeBasis: NEC-style simplified: line current I=VA/V (1-ph) or VA/(V*sqrt3) (3-ph); continuous/motor/xfmr loads x125%; next standard OCPD (240.6(A)); Cu 75C ampacity (310.16 + 240.4(D)); demand: lighting 100%, receptacles first 10 kVA 100% then 50% (220.44), motors +25% of largest (430.24).
